title.narrative: Multi Donor Programmatic Trust Fund for Europe and Central Asia Public Finance Management

description.narrative: THIS IS AN UMBRELLA PROGRAMMATIC TRUST FUND TO PROVIDE A FLEXIBLE source of technical assistance financing on various dimensions of public finance management (PFM) to individual ECA countries or groups of countries on a needs basis. The main objective of this Trust Fund is to support improvements in public financial management in Europe and Central Asia (ECA) (with emphasis on IDA beneficiaries) as an important element of stronger governance and improved conditions for economic and social development.
